case_number: 2025 INSC 146; Miscellaneous Application No. 1773/2021 in Civil Appeal No. 7064/2019
summary: Clarification of prospective application of Tarsem Singh judgment; land acquisition under NHAI Act; Sections 23(2), 28, Land Acquisition Act, 1894 read into NHAI Act; solatium and interest awarded; retrospective application rejected due to finality of proceedings, economic burden, and doctrine of immutability; Gurpreet Singh principles applied; relief limited to pending cases as of 2008; closed acquisitions not reopened.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
Gurpreet Singh v. Union of India, (2006) 8 SCC 457
final_judgment: Miscellaneous Application allowed in part; Tarsem Singh judgment clarified to apply prospectively; no reopening of concluded land acquisition cases; relief for solatium and interest limited to cases pending as of 28.03.2008.
